sources.resource_name: Effects of Collagen Supplements on Skin Aging: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
sources.notes: Am J Med. 2025;138(9):1264-1277. DOI:10.1016/j.amjmed.2025.04.034. 23 RCTs, 1,474 participants; reported no benefit in non-pharma-funded and high-quality-study subgroups; authors concluded no clinical evidence to support collagen for skin aging.

sources.resource_name: Inositol for Polycystic Ovary Syndrome: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis to Inform the 2023 Update of the International Evidence-based PCOS Guidelines
sources.notes: 30 trials, 2,230 participants. Evidence limited/inconclusive; do not extrapolate beyond PCOS-specific outcomes or infer general wellness benefits.

sources.resource_name: Recommendations From the 2023 International Evidence-based Guideline for the Assessment and Management of Polycystic Ovary Syndrome
sources.notes: Inositol may be considered according to preferences with limited clinical benefits; specific types, doses or combinations cannot be recommended due to lack of quality evidence.
